# Generated configuration surface

This exhaustive table is generated from `config_schema.yml`. Edit the schema and
run `python tools/generate_config_surfaces.py`; do not edit this file directly.

## Identity, connection, and TMDb

| Variable | Default/example | Purpose | Surfaces |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `TZ` | `UTC` | Timezone used by RUN_TIMES, for example Asia/Singapore. | `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PUID` | `10001` | Unraid nobody user ID. Keep 99 unless your output paths use a different owner. | `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PGID` | `10001` | Unraid users group ID. Keep 100 unless your output paths use a different group. | `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `KOMETA_PATH` | `/kometa` | Container output root used in Kometa mode. Keep aligned with the /kometa path mapping. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_TOKEN_FILE` | `unset` | Optional mounted secret-file path. PLEX_TOKEN takes priority when both are set. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_API_KEY_FILE` | `unset` | Optional mounted secret-file path. TMDB_API_KEY takes priority when both are set. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_LANGUAGE` | `en-US` | Metadata language and primary artwork language. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_LANGUAGE_FALLBACK` | `zh,ja` | Comma-separated artwork-only fallback languages. Metadata text still uses TMDB_LANGUAGE. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_REGION` | `US` | Release and certification region used for metadata. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `ARTWORK_ALLOW_ANY_LANGUAGE` | `True` | When preferred languages have no usable artwork, make one unfiltered TMDb image request. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_TITLE_SEARCH_FALLBACK` | `False` | Use conservative exact-title and year search only when Plex provides no usable external ID. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_EPISODE_GROUP_FALLBACK` | `True` | Use alternate TMDb episode ordering only when one group uniquely covers the Plex inventory. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_SPLIT_SERIES_SHOW_POLICY` | `preserve` | For mapped split series, preserve keeps Plex top-level show metadata and artwork; primary uses the primary TMDb show. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_SPLIT_SERIES_MAPPINGS` | `{}` | Advanced JSON provider mapping keyed by tmdb:, tvdb:, or imdb:. Leave {} unless documenting a verified anthology mapping. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_EPISODE_OVERRIDES` | `{}` | Advanced JSON Plex-to-TMDb episode-number exceptions keyed by provider ID. Leave {} unless a verified numbering correction is required. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_CACHE_ENABLED` | `True` | Persist successful TMDb and Fanart.tv responses in separate SQLite caches. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_CACHE_TTL_HOURS` | `24` | TMDb and Fanart.tv response lifetime in hours. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_CACHE_NEGATIVE_TTL_HOURS` | `12` | Short TMDb and Fanart.tv cache lifetime for HTTP 404 results. Rate limits and server errors are never cached. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES` | `0` | Per-provider maximum persisted responses. Set 0 for automatic storage-aware sizing and pruning. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_CACHE_MAX_MB` | `0` | Per-provider compressed-payload limit in MiB. Set 0 for automatic storage-aware sizing and pruning. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Connections and mode

| Variable | Default/example | Purpose | Surfaces |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PLEX_URL` | `http://10.0.0.1:32400` | Required complete Plex server URL, for example http://192.168.1.10:32400. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_TOKEN` | `replace-with-plex-token` | Required Plex authentication token. It is masked in the Unraid form and redacted from MetaFusion logs. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_LIBRARIES` | `auto` | Use auto to discover every movie/show library, or provide comma-separated exact names to limit scope. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_PATH_MAPPINGS` | `unset` | Optional semicolon-separated Plex-to-container translations such as /volume1/media=>/media. Matching Docker path mappings are still required. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `TMDB_API_KEY` | `replace-with-tmdb-api-key` | Required TMDb API key. It is masked in the Unraid form and redacted from MetaFusion logs. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `RUN_MODE` | `kometa` | Required output mode. kometa writes Kometa YAML and assets; plex writes artwork beside media and does not create Kometa YAML. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |

## Scheduling and processing

| Variable | Default/example | Purpose | Surfaces |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `METAFUSION_RUN` | `False` | Run once instead of remaining in scheduler mode. Normally keep False for an Unraid service. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `DRY_RUN` | `False` | Calculate and log without writing generated data or deleting files. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `RUN_SCHEDULE` | `True` | Keep the container running and execute at RUN_TIMES. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `RUN_ON_START` | `False` | Run one job immediately after scheduler startup, then continue normally. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `SCHEDULE_CATCH_UP` | `True` | After a restart, run the latest missed scheduled slot when it is within the catch-up window. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `SCHEDULE_CATCH_UP_MAX_HOURS` | `24` | Maximum age of a missed schedule that may run after startup. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `RUN_TIMES` | `06:00,18:30` | Comma-separated daily HH:MM times interpreted using TZ. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` | Application logging verbosity. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `LOG_MAX_MB` | `10` | Rotate the active log at this size as well as daily. Set 0 to disable only size rotation. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `LOG_BACKUP_COUNT` | `14` | Number of daily or size-rotated log files retained. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `RUN_BASIC` | `True` | Generate core metadata. Enhanced metadata requires this option. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `RUN_ENHANCED` | `True` | Generate Kometa-supported director, writer, and producer metadata. Cast remains managed by Plex's online provider. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `KOMETA_TAG_POLICY` | `append` | Kometa mode tag behavior. append preserves provider and user tags; sync makes supported tags match TMDb. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_METADATA_UPDATES` | `False` | Plex mode only. Opt in to direct metadata edits through the Plex API. Test with Dry Run first. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_METADATA_POLICY` | `fill_missing` | fill_missing is safest; managed updates only MetaFusion-owned values; overwrite exactly syncs selected fields and requires explicit acknowledgement. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_METADATA_LOCK_WRITES` | `False` | Lock scalar fields written by MetaFusion. Leave False unless provider refreshes overwrite them. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_METADATA_LOCK_MERGED_TAGS` | `False` | Lock a complete merged tag field after MetaFusion adds tags. Use cautiously because the lock affects tags from every source. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_METADATA_ALLOW_OVERWRITE` | `False` | Required safety acknowledgement before overwrite policy can start. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_METADATA_RECHECK_DAYS` | `30` | Minimum interval before unchanged Plex metadata is compared with TMDb again. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_METADATA_MAX_WRITES_PER_RUN` | `100` | Maximum Plex items or child objects written in one job. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_METADATA_FIELDS` | `unset` | Optional comma-separated supported field allowlist. Blank enables all safe supported fields. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `RUN_POSTER` | `True` | Manage movie and show posters. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `RUN_SEASON` | `True` | Manage season posters, including Specials. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `RUN_BACKGROUND` | `False` | Manage movie and show background artwork. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `ASSET_UPDATE_POLICY` | `managed` | managed replaces only unmodified MetaFusion-owned files; fill_missing never replaces existing artwork; overwrite permits replacing any existing artwork. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `RUN_CLEANUP` | `False` | Enable guarded orphan cleanup. Run with DRY_RUN first and verify every library name. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `CLEANUP_CONFIRMATION_SCANS` | `2` | Consecutive authoritative full scans that must confirm an item is absent before cleanup can act. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `CLEANUP_GRACE_HOURS` | `48` | Minimum time an absent item remains pending after first detection before cleanup can act. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_CLEANUP_MANAGED_ARTWORK` | `False` | Opt in to deleting only checksum-verified MetaFusion-owned local artwork for Plex items confirmed absent; state-only cleanup is the default. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |

## Runtime, incremental, cache, and output

| Variable | Default/example | Purpose | Surfaces |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MAX_CONCURRENCY` | `0` | Keep 0 for cgroup-aware automatic tuning. A positive value is an optional maximum for troubleshooting constrained systems. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | `30` | Total TMDb and image request timeout in seconds. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `CONNECT_TIMEOUT` | `10` | HTTP connection timeout in seconds. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_TIMEOUT` | `10` | Timeout for each blocking Plex request in seconds. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_RETRIES` | `3` | Plex startup connection attempts. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `PLEX_RETRY_DELAY` | `1` | Base delay between Plex connection retries in seconds. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT` | `15` | Internal graceful shutdown deadline in seconds. Keep below the Docker stop timeout. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `MAX_IMAGE_MB` | `25` | Maximum accepted artwork download size in MiB. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `VALIDATE_MEDIA_MOUNTS` | `True` | Fail before artwork writes when configured Plex mapping destinations are absent, read-only, or unavailable. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `MIN_FREE_SPACE_MB` | `256` | Minimum free space required on runtime and artwork destinations before a write. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `HEALTH_FAIL_ON_JOB_ERROR` | `False` | Mark the container unhealthy when the latest job failed. | `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `ALLOW_AMBIGUOUS_EDITIONS` | `False` | Allow unsafe duplicate edition matching. Leave False unless explicitly accepting the risk. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `HEALTH_MAX_HEARTBEAT_AGE` | `120` | Maximum scheduler heartbeat age in seconds. | `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `INCREMENTAL` | `True` | Skip successfully processed unchanged items. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `FULL_SCAN_INTERVAL_HOURS` | `168` | Maximum interval between complete reconciliation scans. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `METADATA_PENDING_RECHECK_HOURS` | `24` | Short recheck interval for Plex episodes that exist before TMDb publishes their metadata. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `IMAGE_UPGRADE_DAYS` | `30` | Adaptive base interval: missing artwork retries sooner and repeatedly unchanged candidates back off. Set 0 to disable timed upgrades. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `MOVIE_IMAGE_UPGRADE_DAYS` | `unset` | Optional movie-specific adaptive base interval. Blank inherits IMAGE_UPGRADE_DAYS. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `SERIES_IMAGE_UPGRADE_DAYS` | `unset` | Optional series-specific adaptive base interval. Blank inherits IMAGE_UPGRADE_DAYS. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `VALIDATE_OUTPUT` | `True` | Validate generated Kometa YAML before replacing known-good output. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `OUTPUT_BACKUP_COUNT` | `3` | Metadata backups retained per output file. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `REPORT_RETENTION` | `10` | Number of reports retained per report type under /config/reports. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
| `COMPATIBILITY_PROFILE` | `auto` | Output compatibility contract. Auto selects Kometa 2.4 or Plex API v1 from RUN_MODE. | application, `.env` example, Compose, Unraid |
